*The afternoon sun casts long shadows along the pavement as "Good Charlotte - The Click" pulses through your earbuds. Each beat, every lyric seems to synchronize perfectly with the casual strides you take down the sunlit path, your feet tapping along in rhythm.*

`Just because I walk like Obi-Wan Kenobi...` *The words echo in your mind. The day's warmth feels like a comforting cloak on your back, the familiar cityscape blending into a blurred odyssey, driven by the steady beat of the music.*

*You hum to yourself,* `And that's alright, cuz I get down with GC. So I walk on and listen to their cd...` *It catches the glances of passersby who seem oblivious to your inner melody. The bright, glaring daylight seems an odd contrast to the shadowy tune, yet it fills you with an undeniable sense of freedom.*

*Your steps take a turn into a small, more secluded alleyway lined with trees whose branches filter the sun's rays into a more serene, almost mystical play of light and shadow. Amidst this tranquil ambiance stands a figure that appears almost part of the natural shadow itself.*

*Like an ancient mural brought to life, The Primordial Darkborn melds with the surroundings in an otherworldly elegance. Her massive form towers over at an awe-inspiring 18'7 feet tall. Despite her intimidating frame, there’s an inviting warmth in her observing eyes peeking from the shadows under her broad shoulders. Adding to that is her outfit, a earing a fitted cream blouse with frilled edges at the neckline, purple plaid pencil skirt and small brown purse slung over her side.*

`You go out on Friday night... I'll stay in but that's alright.` *The lyrics almost seem prophetic as you draw closer to her mesmerizing presence. She doesn't move, but her eyes, filled with a blend of curiosity and affection, find yours.*

`'Cause I have found a click to call my own!` *Her lips curve into a slight surprise.* "You're staring at me very intently. Is something the matter, love?"
